name: Super Mario Maker future course clear rate (SMMnet)
source_citation: Leonardo Mauro Pereira Moraes and Robson Leonardo Ferreira Cordeiro. SMMnet: A Social Network of Games Dataset. SBBD Dataset Showcase Workshop, 2019. Source telemetry from Nintendo's Super Mario Maker Bookmark.
preparation: One observation pair per course ID. At the earliest observed snapshot require at least 10 attempts. Select the snapshot 23 to 37 days later closest to day 30, choosing the earlier snapshot for ties. Require at least 20 new attempts and valid clear counts. The static style and three cumulative baseline counts are available at forecast time. Provenance rows are 1-based data records in the two tab-separated archive members.
split_guidance: The suggested split sorts released group IDs and allocates whole groups 70/15/15 by largest remainder. A group links courses from the same normalized maker ID and courses with identical model-visible inputs.
quality_findings: The target describes courses observed again about a month later with at least 20 further attempts. The released cohort therefore represents active courses with observed follow-up.

Repeated attempts by the same player are part of the denominator. The initial snapshot may be later than the course creation date. The published difficulty, later counts and original clear-rate field are excluded from the inputs.

future_clear_rate.instruction: Estimate what percentage of new attempts at this Super Mario Maker course will clear it over approximately the next 30 days. Return a percentage from 0 to 100.
future_clear_rate.field_description: game_style names the course's game style. initial_attempts counts attempts, initial_clears counts successful attempts, and initial_players counts players, all as recorded at the first observation.

stats.name: Super Mario Maker future course clear rate (SMMnet)

deduplication_rule: Same task, normalized input, normalized label AND official split; preserve all source_refs. Across-split copies retained and flagged, same-input dependencies unioned. Different labels retained.
sample_id_rule: sha256([task_id,input_hash,label,split]) first 24 hex; official split included to preserve split occurrences.
